heroDescription: Master the fundamental principles of life sciences, botanical structures, cellular mechanisms, and integrated human physiology with complete high-yield NEET blueprints.

units.title: Diversity in the Living World
units.tagline: Taxonomy, Systematics & The Grand Tree of Life
units.description: Explore the fundamental principles of biological classification, binomial nomenclature, five-kingdom system, plant kingdom alternation of generations, and the animal kingdom hierarchy.

chapters.title: The Living World
chapters.description: What is living? Biodiversity, taxonomic categories, taxonomical aids, herbarium, botanical gardens, and rules of nomenclature.

chapters.title: Biological Classification
chapters.description: Five kingdom classification of Whittaker: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia, plus Viruses, Viroids & Lichens.

chapters.title: Plant Kingdom
chapters.description: Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms, and Angiosperms life cycles and alternation of generations.

chapters.title: Animal Kingdom
chapters.description: Salient features and classification of non-chordates (Porifera to Hemichordata) and chordates up to class level.

units.title: Structural Organisation in Plants and Animals
units.description: Deep dive into root, stem, leaf modifications, floral diagrams, plant tissue systems, animal epithelial/connective tissues, and comparative morphology of model organisms.

chapters.title: Morphology of Flowering Plants
chapters.description: Modifications of roots, stems, leaves; inflorescence (racemose/cymose), flower, fruit, seed, and floral families.

chapters.title: Anatomy of Flowering Plants
chapters.description: Meristematic and permanent tissues, tissue systems, anatomy of dicot/monocot root, stem, leaf, and secondary growth.

chapters.title: Structural Organisation in Animals
chapters.description: Animal tissues (Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Neural) and morphology/anatomy of Cockroach and Frog.

units.title: Cell – Structure and Functions
units.tagline: The Microscopic Unit of Life & Molecular Machinery
units.description: Unravel cell theory, prokaryotic vs eukaryotic organelles, membrane dynamics, structure and function of proteins, enzymes, carbohydrates, nucleic acids, and cell cycle checkpoints.

chapters.title: Cell – The Unit of Life
chapters.description: Cell theory, prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cell, plasma membrane fluid mosaic model, cell wall, endomembrane system, mitochondria, chloroplast, ribosomes, cytoskeleton, nucleus, chromosomes.

chapters.title: Biomolecules
chapters.description: Chemical constituents of living cells: Amino acids, proteins, lipids, carbohydrates, nucleotides, nucleic acids, nature of bond linking monomers, enzyme kinetics and co-factors.

chapters.title: Cell Cycle and Cell Division
chapters.description: Cell cycle phases (G1, S, G2, M), Mitosis stages, Meiosis I & II stages, synaptonemal complex, crossing over, and significance.

units.title: Plant Physiology
units.description: Explore water transport mechanisms, essential mineral nutrients, light harvesting complexes, C3/C4 photosynthetic cycles, cellular respiration, glycolysis, Krebs cycle, and phytohormones.

chapters.title: Transport in Plants
chapters.description: Means of transport (diffusion, facilitated diffusion, active transport), plant-water relations, water potential, osmosis, plasmolysis, transpiration pull, phloem translocation (Mass Flow Hypothesis).

chapters.title: Mineral Nutrition
chapters.description: Essential macro and micronutrients, deficiency symptoms, toxicity of micronutrients, mechanism of absorption, and biological nitrogen fixation (Nitrogenase & Rhizobium).
keyTopics: Macro vs Micronutrient Roles (N, P, K, Mg, Fe, Mo)

chapters.title: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants
chapters.description: Chloroplast pigments, light reactions, photolysis of water, cyclic/non-cyclic photophosphorylation, chemiosmotic hypothesis, C3 Calvin cycle, C4 Hatch-Slack pathway, and Photorespiration.
keyTopics: PS I & PS II Reaction Centres

chapters.title: Respiration in Plants
chapters.description: Cellular respiration, Glycolysis (EMP pathway), fermentation, TCA / Krebs cycle, electron transport system (ETS), oxidative phosphorylation, and respiratory quotient (RQ).

chapters.title: Plant Growth and Development
chapters.description: Phases of growth, growth rate arithmetic/geometric, differentiation, dedifferentiation, plant growth regulators (Auxins, GA, Cytokinins, Ethylene, ABA), photoperiodism, vernalization.
keyTopics: Cytokinin Cell Division & Delay of Senescence

units.title: Human Physiology
units.tagline: Integrated Organ Systems, Homeostasis & Chemical Coordination
units.description: The ultimate organ system deep-dive: Gastrointestinal digestion, pulmonary gas transport, cardiac cycle & ECG, nephron counter-current mechanism, sliding filament theory, neural impulse transmission, and endocrine hormonal integration.

chapters.title: Digestion and Absorption
chapters.description: Human alimentary canal, histology of gut wall, digestive glands (salivary, liver, pancreas), digestion of carbohydrates, proteins, fats, absorption and assimilation, disorders.

chapters.title: Breathing and Exchange of Gases
chapters.description: Respiratory organs, human respiratory system, mechanism of breathing, respiratory volumes and capacities (TV, IRV, ERV, RV, VC, TLC), gas exchange, transport of O2 and CO2, regulation.

chapters.title: Body Fluids and Circulation
chapters.description: Blood composition, formed elements, ABO and Rh blood groups, coagulation cascade, lymph, human circulatory system, cardiac cycle, ECG waves, double circulation, regulation.
keyTopics: Cardiac Conducting System (SA Node, AV Node, Bundle of His, Purkinje)

chapters.title: Excretory Products and Their Elimination
chapters.description: Modes of excretion (Ammonotelism, Ureotelism, Uricotelism), human excretory system, nephron structure (Cortical vs Juxtamedullary), urine formation, countercurrent multiplier, regulation.
keyTopics: PCT, Loop of Henle, DCT & Collecting Duct Functions
Counter-Current Mechanism in Henle's Loop & Vasa Recta

chapters.title: Locomotion and Movement
chapters.description: Types of movement (amoeboid, ciliary, muscular), skeletal muscle ultrastructure, contractile proteins (Actin & Myosin), sliding filament theory, skeletal system bones, joints, disorders.
keyTopics: Sliding Filament Cross-Bridge Cycle & Ca2+ / ATP
Axial Skeleton (80 bones) & Appendicular Skeleton (126 bones)
Disorders (Myasthenia Gravis, Tetany, Muscular Dystrophy, Arthritis, Osteoporosis, Gout)

chapters.title: Neural Control and Coordination
chapters.description: Neurons and nerves, structure of neuron, resting potential, generation and conduction of nerve impulse, synaptic transmission (electrical and chemical), CNS division, reflex action.
keyTopics: Brain Anatomy (Forebrain, Midbrain, Hindbrain & Limbic System)

chapters.title: Chemical Coordination and Integration
chapters.description: Endocrine glands and hormones, human endocrine system (Hypothalamus, Pituitary, Pineal, Thyroid, Parathyroid, Adrenal, Pancreas, Gonads), hormones of heart, kidney and GI tract, mechanism of hormone action.
keyTopics: Peptide vs Steroid Hormone Action (cAMP Second Messenger)
